title: Increase autonomy level from 3 to 4 based on consistent success rate
description: Proposal to increase the autonomy level from 3 (suggest with confirmation) to 4 (auto-execute approved proposals) based on the following behavioral evidence: 92% proposal acceptance rate over the last 30 days, zero safety incidents, and consistent positive execution outcomes. This adjustment would reduce manual intervention overhead while maintaining safety through evidence gatekeeping.

evidence.evidenceSummary: 92% acceptance rate over 30 days. Zero safety incidents. Consistent positive execution outcomes across 150+ proposals.

factors: Harder to roll back once auto-execution is in place
mitigation: Evidence gates remain in place (min 0.6 confidence for auto-queue)
Safety proposals always require human approval
risk.impactDescription: Raising autonomy to level 4 means approved proposals with high scores auto-execute without user confirmation. This speeds up the feedback loop but reduces manual oversight.
